name: broods
description: Multi-account AI agent harness built on Bun. The source-available engine behind Broods.

scripts.check: bun run lint:types && bun run format:check && bun run --filter @broods/core check && bun run --filter @broods/convex check && bun run --filter @broods/gateway check && bun run --filter @broods/edge check && bun run --filter @broods/dashboard check && bun run --filter @broods/discord-forwarder check && bun run --filter @broods/matrix-forwarder check && bun run --filter @broods/cloudflare-mcp check && bun run --filter @broods/cloudflare-sandbox check && bun run --filter @broods/cloudflare-worker check && bun run --filter broods check && bun run --filter @broods/ai-sdk-sandbox check && bun run --filter @broods/docs check && bun run scripts:check && bun run bench:types
scripts.verification:test: bun run --filter @broods/convex test -- tests/cliSyncRevision.test.ts tests/cliSyncExternalPrune.test.ts tests/cliSyncPrune.test.ts tests/cliSyncEnvRefs.test.ts tests/cron.test.ts tests/runtimeIngress.test.ts tests/runtime.test.ts && bun test --max-concurrency=1 apps/core/tests/ingress.test.ts apps/core/tests/cron-run.test.ts apps/core/tests/async-tools.test.ts apps/core/tests/subagents.test.ts apps/edge/tests apps/gateway/tests/route.test.ts packages/broods/tests/resources.test.ts packages/broods/tests/cli-env-sync.test.ts packages/broods/tests/sync-revision.test.ts
scripts.test: bun test scripts/ bench/; status=$?; bun run --sequential --no-exit-on-error --filter '*' test && exit $status
